chapter.heading: Ezra 3
Rebuilding the Altar
chapter.v: When the seventh month came, and the children of Israel were in the towns, the people gathered as one man to Jerusalem.
they offered burnt offerings on it to the Lord , burnt offerings morning and evening.
and offered the daily burnt offerings by number according to the rule, as each day required,
and at all the appointed feasts of the Lord , and the offerings of everyone who made a freewill offering to the Lord .
From the first day of the seventh month they began to offer burnt offerings to the Lord . But the foundation of the temple of the Lord was not yet laid.
according to the grant that they had from Cyrus king of Persia.
supervise the work of the house of the Lord .

And Jeshua with his sons and his brothers, and Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together supervised the workmen in the house of God, along with thesons of Henadad and the Levites, their sons and brothers.
according to the directions of David king of Israel.
And all the people shouted with a great shout when they praised the Lord , because the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid.
old men who had seen the first house, wept with a loud voice when they saw the foundation of this house being laid, though many shouted aloud for joy,
so that the people could not distinguish the sound of the joyful shout from the sound of the people's weeping, for the people shouted with a great shout, and the sound was heard far away.
